comparison.objective: Candidate screens media from finished washers; record measures subfloor flatness and reports PASS or FAIL.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests tool-driven particle classification; record tests straightedge placement, wedge insertion at the deepest gap and measurement-based classification.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires physical batch separation and quantitative recovery; record requires correct straightedge reference, deepest-gap reading and correct tag placement.
comparison.reason: Both end in classification, but the record classifies a surface from a measurement while the candidate physically separates mixed objects.
